evidence.title: Nürnberg NLP @ GermEval Shared Task 2026: Harmful Content Detection in German Social Media through Error-Independent LLM Voters

summary: The Nürnberg NLP team presented a method using error-independent LLM voters to detect harmful content in German social media as part of the GermEval 2026 Shared Task. Their approach aims to improve robustness in identifying toxic or harmful language.
title: Nürnberg NLP Team Uses LLM Voters for Harmful Content Detection in German Social Media at GermEval 2026
